node.title: The fixed rank-nine component target is impossible at every shortening
node.closure: small-dimension core contradiction plus large-dimension weighted incidence gap
node.statement: The rank-nine affine-owner alternative in the fixed nine-subset target router cannot occur. If K'<=67472, its forced common core of size at least 134944 cannot lie in an owner core of size below m'=67472+K'. If K'>=67473, the weighted selector demand exceeds the universal rank-nine cap; at K'=67473 the exact values are 6849288576200976639 > 147748596828055575, and the demand-to-cap ratio increases with K'. Thus the residual fixed target is reduced to the kernel chart or rank-eight owner-flat alternatives.
